kms2.review: SageNarwhal2 He was good overall but his classes might seem to be ineffective as they seemed to be short. And coping up with his exam taking styles might be difficult as he conducts all of them virtually. Also questions are a bit difficult sometimes. So focus in classes, but lastly he is a nice person.

If you want to get an A in mis310 it's better if you learn SQL before hand and then do the course. There are only 2 theoretical chapters that he takes a mid on and 3 assignments based on those chapters ( be careful because he is nitpicks alot ). As for the practical part you would need to be part of a group or do it alone. Your marks will depend alot on your group performance. The final contains about 40% of your entire grade and its nothing like the lab exam ( 10 marks and which is easy to ace). And he doesn't curve even if the entire class does bad unlike other mis faculties so your cgpa is at complete risk.
